core: Nucleic acid deamination editing in antiviral defense
qualifier: ADAR adenosine-to-inosine editing alongside APOBEC cytidine deamination
name: Adenosine and cytidine deamination editing in antiviral defense
rationale: All members concern deaminase-based base editing (ADAR A-to-I, APOBEC C-to-U) and its use against viral nucleic acids; the ADAR editosome arm separates it from HIV-entry, DNA-demethylation and somatic-hypermutation neighbours.

name: Taste and smell chemosensory perception
rationale: Members cover the five taste modalities, olfactory/pheromone receptors and the TRP, TALK and acid-sensing channels used in sour taste; the taste/olfactory receptor content separates it from pain, CFTR and general K2P-channel neighbours.

core: Receptor tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS and PI3K/AKT
qualifier: centered on MET, with erythropoietin and IGF1R adaptors
name: MET-centered tyrosine kinase signaling to RAS and PI3K
rationale: Members are RTK/cytokine-receptor adaptor cascades (SHC, SOS, IRS, PLCG) feeding RAS-ERK and PI3K-AKT, dominated by MET/HGF signaling, which separates it from ERBB, EPO-STAT5 and AKT2 neighbours.

qualifier: base excision, mismatch and direct-reversal repair
name: Base excision, mismatch and direct-reversal DNA repair
rationale: Members are glycosylase-initiated BER (including TET/TDG demethylation), mismatch repair, alkylation reversal and cross-link repair with their disease variants, distinguishing them from the NER, translesion and immunoglobulin-mutation neighbours.

qualifier: sulfated chains with their inherited enzyme defects
name: Sulfated glycosaminoglycan biosynthesis and its inherited defects
rationale: Members cover linkage-region, chondroitin, dermatan, heparan and keratan sulfate synthesis and the congenital disorders of those enzymes, separating them from Notch O-glycosylation, cartilage sulfate transport and dystroglycan glycosylation neighbours.

name: Rhesus glycoprotein ammonium and carbon dioxide transport
rationale: Members concern Rh-family membrane proteins, their biosynthesis and deficiency, and the ammonium/CO2 transmembrane transport they mediate, distinguishing them from erythrocyte oxygen exchange and peptide-transport neighbours.

name: Cell-substrate adhesion and spreading with MET-FAK signaling
rationale: Members are integrin/syndecan-mediated attachment, spreading and stress-fiber assembly, and the MET-PTK2 and MET-tensin members are exactly what the cytoskeletal, migration and matrix neighbours lack.

name: Fanconi anemia cross-link repair with monoubiquitination cycling
rationale: Members concern the Fanconi anemia pathway, its FANCD2/FANCI monoubiquitination and USP1-type deubiquitination, and the checkpoint and recombination-resolution steps it supports; the monoubiquitination cycle separates it from homologous-recombination and telomere neighbours.

qualifier: leukotrienes and cytochrome P450 hydroxylase/epoxygenase products
name: Leukotriene and cytochrome P450 eicosanoid synthesis and catabolism
rationale: Members cover leukotriene synthesis, transport and breakdown plus P450 omega-hydroxylase (HETE) and epoxygenase (EET) eicosanoids; the P450 and leukotriene arms distinguish it from lipoxin/lipoxygenase and leukotriene-receptor neighbours.

qualifier: BCL-2 family and p53 transcriptional targets
name: BCL-2 family mitochondrial apoptosis and p53 apoptotic gene transcription
rationale: Members are BH3-only/BAX/BAK-driven outer membrane permeabilization, cytochrome c and SMAC release, apoptosome caspase activation and p53 transcription of these genes, distinguishing them from extrinsic/necroptotic and p53-signaling-only neighbours.

name: Glucose glycolysis and gluconeogenesis, including GLUT1 and hexokinase deficiency
rationale: Members are central glucose catabolism and synthesis through glucose-6-phosphate and fructose-1,6-bisphosphate plus defects in glucose uptake and phosphorylation, separating them from fructose/galactose/pentose and glycogen neighbours.

name: Retroviral and retroelement control with immunoglobulin gene diversification
rationale: Members span the retroviral DNA life cycle and its host restriction (APOBEC3G, HUSH, KRAB-ZFP silencing, HCMV events) together with V(D)J recombination, somatic hypermutation and class switching, which separates it from the RNA-virus replication and translation neighbours.

name: CC chemokine production driving monocyte-macrophage recruitment
rationale: Members regulate CCL5, MCP-1 and MIP-1 alpha production and macrophage chemotaxis, distinguishing them from the neutrophil/CXC-chemokine and dendritic-cell/cGAS neighbours.

name: Cobalamin absorption and transport, including inherited defects
rationale: Members cover intrinsic-factor uptake into enterocytes, transcobalamin carriage and lysosomal export with their deficiencies, distinguishing them from intracellular cobalamin metabolism and methylmalonic acidemia neighbours.

name: Neutrophil degranulation and myeloid cell-mediated cytotoxicity
rationale: Members regulate neutrophil degranulation, neutrophil cytotoxicity and myeloid immune killing, separating them from complement/TLR and respiratory-burst neighbours.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and aspartate family amino acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, aspartate, asparagine and citrulline metabolism and nitrogen utilization; the aspartate/citrulline arm separates it from alanine, proline and TCA-shuttle neighbours.

qualifier: pantothenate-derived CoA and NADP+ cofactor synthesis
name: Coenzyme A, acyl-CoA and NADP+ cofactor metabolism
rationale: Most members concern pantothenate-to-CoA synthesis, malonyl/succinyl/medium-chain acyl-CoA and NAD(P) cofactor supply, with two peroxisome-maintenance members; cofactor synthesis distinguishes it from the TCA and peroxisomal oxidation neighbours.

qualifier: endosome, lysosome and plasma membrane routes
name: Post-Golgi sorting among endosomes, lysosomes and plasma membrane
rationale: Members are TGN-endosome-lysosome transport, retrograde endosome-to-Golgi retrieval and receptor recycling, distinguishing them from COPI, Golgi-structure and membrane-tubulation neighbours.

name: Microautophagy, chaperone-mediated autophagy and aggrephagy
rationale: Members are non-canonical and protein-selective autophagy routes (CMA, endosomal and nuclear microautophagy, aggrephagy) with ATG8 delipidation and nutrient sensing, separating them from stress-granule, ERAD and organelle-phagy neighbours.

qualifier: atypical ERK5 and MAPK4/6 cascades with serine phosphorylation control
name: Atypical ERK5 and MAPK4/6 cascades with serine phosphorylation control
rationale: Members are RAS/MAPK signaling, its atypical ERK5 and MAPK4/6 branches and regulation of serine phosphorylation, distinguishing them from NGF-TRK, ERK-inactivation and RAF-mutant neighbours.

qualifier: centriole duplication, cilium dynamics and spindle positioning
name: Centriole, cilium and spindle-positioning microtubule organization
rationale: Members regulate centriole duplication and cohesion, MTOC nucleation and anchoring, cilium assembly and disassembly and spindle orientation, separating them from mitotic centrosome-maturation and tubulin-modification neighbours.

qualifier: two-pore leak, ATP-sensitive and calcium-activated channels
name: Leak, ATP-sensitive and calcium-activated potassium channels setting membrane potential
rationale: Members are K2P leak channels, KATP channels with their SUR disease variants and KCa channels regulating resting potential and excitability; the KATP and K2P families separate it from Kir, voltage-gated and sodium-transport neighbours.

name: Transcriptional regulation of tumor-relevant genes and PAX3 targets
rationale: Members concern promoter-level control of CDH1, CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1 and TGFBR3, ALK-STAT3 nuclear events and PAX3 target sets, separating them from RUNX3, FOXO and BMP-driven differentiation neighbours.

name: Glycosphingolipid biosynthesis and intermembrane transport
rationale: Members cover ganglioside and galactosylceramide synthesis and glycolipid/ceramide-1-phosphate transfer, distinguishing them from lysosomal catabolism, GPI-anchor and phospholipid-transfer neighbours.

name: Mitochondrial protein processing and degradation
rationale: All three members concern proteolytic processing and turnover of mitochondrial proteins, distinguishing them from mitochondrial import, calcium-uniporter and ER quality-control neighbours.
